connector.name: MCP Amazon
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Amazon Selling Partner API (SP-API) - orders, listings, catalog, inventory, finances
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-amazon. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the codespar account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: AMAZON_LWA_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Login with Amazon (LWA) client_id from Seller Central > Developer Central (SP-API app).

env.name: AMAZON_REFRESH_TOKEN
env.description: Long-lived seller-authorized refresh_token exchanged for 1-hour LWA access tokens used as x-amz-access-token.

env.name: AMAZON_MARKETPLACE_ID
env.description: Default marketplace id. BR: A2Q3Y263D00KWC, US: ATVPDKIKX0DER, MX: A1AM78C64UM0Y8, CA: A2EUQ1WTGCTBG2. Required by most endpoints; can be overridden per-call.

env.name: AMAZON_REGION
env.description: SP-API region: 'na' (default — Americas, incl. BR/US/MX/CA), 'eu' (Europe + India + MENA), 'fe' (Far East — JP/AU/SG).

env.name: AMAZON_SELLER_ID
env.description: Default sellerId (merchant token) used by Listings endpoints. Can be overridden per-call.
